description: Returns instances of the specified recurring event. Use timeMin/timeMax to constrain the window; omitting bounds can return large result sets and is quota-heavy. On high-volume calls, 403 rateLimitExceeded or 429 too_many_requests may occur; apply exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s) before retrying.

calendarId.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the `calendarList.list` method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the "primary" keyword.
calendarId.human_parameter_description: The calendar you want to read from. Use 'primary' for your own calendar or paste a specific calendar ID.
calendarId.title: Calendar Id

eventId.description: REQUIRED. The ID of the recurring event whose instances you want to retrieve. You must first use googlecalendar.find_event or googlecalendar.events_list to find recurring events and get their IDs. This action only works with recurring events that have a recurrence rule.
eventId.human_parameter_description: REQUIRED. The ID of the recurring event whose instances you want to retrieve. First use GOOGLECALENDAR_FIND_EVENT or GOOGLECALENDAR_EVENTS_LIST to search for recurring events and get their IDs. This action only works with recurring events.
eventId.title: Event Id

maxAttendees.description: The maximum number of attendees to include in the response. If there are more than the specified number of attendees, only the participant is returned. Optional.
maxAttendees.human_parameter_description: Limits how many attendees are returned for each instance, helping keep the results short and easier to scan.
maxAttendees.title: Max Attendees

maxResults.description: Maximum number of events returned on one result page. By default the value is 250 events. The page size can never be larger than 2500 events. Optional.
maxResults.human_parameter_description: How many event instances to return per page. Use a smaller number to load results faster.
maxResults.title: Max Results

originalStart.description: The original start time of the instance in the result. Optional.
originalStart.human_parameter_description: If you’re targeting a single instance, enter that instance’s original start time to pinpoint it.
originalStart.title: Original Start

pageToken.description: Token specifying which result page to return. Optional.
pageToken.human_parameter_description: If you got a next page token from a previous call, paste it here to continue where you left off.
pageToken.title: Page Token

showDeleted.description: Whether to include deleted events (with status equals "cancelled") in the result. Cancelled instances of recurring events will still be included if `singleEvents` is False. Optional. The default is False.
showDeleted.human_parameter_description: Include canceled or deleted instances in the results. Turn this on only if you need to see removed occurrences.
showDeleted.title: Show Deleted

timeMax.description: Upper bound (exclusive) for an event's start time to filter by. Optional. The default is not to filter by start time. Must be an RFC3339 timestamp with mandatory time zone offset.
timeMax.human_parameter_description: Only include instances that start before this date and time. Use a full timestamp with time zone.
timeMax.title: Time Max

timeMin.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for an event's end time to filter by. Optional. The default is not to filter by end time. Must be an RFC3339 timestamp with mandatory time zone offset.
timeMin.human_parameter_description: Start of the time window to filter instances. Use a full timestamp with time zone.
timeMin.title: Time Min

timeZone.description: Time zone used in the response. Optional. The default is the time zone of the calendar.
timeZone.human_parameter_description: Choose the time zone for times in the response so they match your preference.
timeZone.title: Time Zone
